_cheater_note: Cheater v4 is implemented but remains OFF for commissioning. Enable only after candidate-set dry-run; one 0.33x whole-family PROBE seat maximum.
_promotions_note: Parent-metric lane ON per operator decision 2026-08-03 (bar relaxed to n>=10 raw episodes, >=5 independent days; avg/LCB/FDR gates unchanged). All promotions land on PROBE 0.33x, max 2/run, cluster-filtered. Cheater lane still commissioned separately by the Commissioner.
_strikes_note: STRIKE RULE 2026-08-03 (operator): every executed demotion is a permanent strike (governor_state.demotion_counts, badge on the dashboard). Ever-demoted cells promote only over the redemption bar 20/10; the 3rd strike flips the cell to DISABLED — manual re-enable only.
_truth_gate_note: TRUTH-CHECK GATE 2026-08-04 (operator): a shadow whose virtual family-cycle sign contradicts its own broker fills (full window) cannot promote — proven-wrong sim never spends money.
_seat_note: SEAT POOLS 2026-08-06; ceiling raised 6->9 by operator 2026-08-07. max_probe_seats_total is the durable risk ceiling across BOTH lanes (derived from cell status, survives loss of governor state). 2026-08-07 rationale: post-B-121 rescore surfaced 8 shadows at n>=10 with LCB>0 (mr2_bb_reversion/rg1_range_scalp family consistent across 4 pairs) while all 6 seats were full — discovery was outrunning audition capacity. 3 new seats + max_promotions 3/run let the docket flow; PROBE 0.33x sizing, truth gate, probe leash, three-strikes and broker-cycle graduation unchanged. Commissioned cheater lane seat stays RESERVED, never first-come. Concurrent RISK is bounded separately by the party-package caps (max_total_trades / max_margin_pct_total), not by this. Seat-ceiling deferrals do not write last_eval_blocks, so no peeking-guard reset was needed for this change.
_fdr_note: fdr_q RAISED 0.05 -> 0.10 by operator decision 2026-08-06: accept ~10% of admissions being flukes in exchange for testing marginal ideas faster. Justified by what sits BEHIND admission — every promotion lands on a 0.33x PROBE, must earn completed broker family cycles to graduate, and a demotion costs a permanent strike (3 = disabled).
